title: USCIS Case and Evidence Navigator
tagline: A case status is administrative posture—not a prediction or legal judgment.

cards: A short status invites confident interpretation.
Case history, mailed notices, evidence requests, and receipts differ.
Administrative posture cannot support a merits conclusion.
The packet advances with privacy and authorized review intact.

story.headline: The quiet case status beside an unanswered notice
beats: An applicant sees an unchanged online case status.
A separate notice record requests one piece of evidence by a date.
Predicting approval or asking for a new file misses the actual service need.
The navigator preserves the notice, receipt, privacy, and authorized review.
